Authenticode checked before bundling: Valid; signer namazso (namazso.eu).

Mizu invokes the default signed edition with: -install -silent
It requests Windows administrator approval when the user clicks Install.
Installation is not performed when Mizu launches or when temperature is toggled.
Mizu's current temperature implementation supports x64 Windows 10 1809+ and
Windows 11 only. The x86 app may use it when running on x64 Windows.
32-bit Windows and ARM Windows temperature reading remain unsupported.

PawnIO is a shared system component. Mizu does not uninstall it on exit.
It can be uninstalled separately using Windows Installed Apps.
After installation, restart Mizu as administrator to refresh LHM driver detection.
If the installer returns 3010, save work and reboot Windows manually.
No security policy, memory integrity, or boot settings are changed by Mizu.
